name: sign-in
title: Sign in
description: A two-step sign-in made only with mangacn. On the start side a big manga Panel: a reader drawn in SVG (ink lines, paper fills, a screentone jacket), focus SpeedLines around her, a SpeechBubble whose line changes with each step, Sfx lettering and a PanelCaption; on phones the panel shrinks to a short banner above the form. On the end side the form, in a case (G1) when there is room: email and password Fields with Input, labels and shaking FieldErrors on submit, a 'Keep me signed in' Checkbox, a Sign in Button with its loading state, a FieldSeparator divider and a sign-up link. The second step asks for a one-time code with InputOTP (6 digits), shows a resend link after a 30 s countdown and the error look (accent lines, '!' mark) for the wrong code 000000; any other code signs in and shows a brush check. No network, links do not navigate. One column on phones with 44px touch targets; container queries widen it. Works in light, dark, any accent and with Radix or Base UI.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/blocks/sign-in". The root fills its container width; the panel and the form sit side by side once the block is 48rem wide. Replace the simulated timeouts in signIn and verify with your own auth calls.
